rows.note: This is the all-purpose command to urge a horse or other animal forward or faster.

example.english: The carter shouted “gee,” and the horse immediately went faster.
example.traditional: 馬夫大喝一聲「駕」，匹馬即刻跑快啲。
example.jyutping: maa5 fu1 daai6 hot3 jat1 seng1 gaa3 pat1 maa5 zik1 hak1 paau2 faai3 di1

rows.note: Use this when the command specifically means for the animal to turn right.

example.english: The carter shouted “gee right; don’t go straight!” at the horse.
example.traditional: 馬夫向匹馬喊：「右轉，唔好行直路！」
example.jyutping: maa5 fu1 hoeng3 pat1 maa5 haam3 jau6 zyun3 m4 hou2 haang4 zik6 lou6
